svg.text: Private Subnet · assignPublicIp=DISABLED · NAT Gateway → Internet Gateway · Single AZ
Scanner image — pulled via NAT GW
Note: NAT GW itself uses this route to reach internet via IGW
assignPublicIp = DISABLED · No public IP assigned
Outbound internet via NAT Gateway — inbound: none
No inbound rules — scanner tasks are never reached inbound
TCP 443 → 0.0.0.0/0 (HTTPS to internet via NAT GW)
vCPU: 0.5 (256 units) · Memory: 512 MB dev / 1 GB prod · Launched by EventBridge Pipe
+ delete. Fargate reads msg from env.
Outbound Traffic Flow (Fargate → Internet via NAT GW)
Fargate → NAT GW → IGW → Docker Hub (Trivy scans target image ← KEY new capability)
Fargate → NAT GW → IGW → ECR (scanner image pull on task start) · CloudWatch Logs (log streaming)
Fargate → S3 Gateway EP (AWS backbone · free · no NAT cost) · DynamoDB Gateway EP (same)
Cost — NAT Gateway vs VPC Interface Endpoints
Before: 3 × VPC Interface Endpoints (CW Logs + ECR API + ECR DKR, dev+prod) = $43.80/month
Saves ~$12/month AND enables full internet access → Docker Hub image scanning now works
